core.notes:
The Changelog page has lines for this update
Features › Modules: a module's add-ons are listed under it, marked Included (they load with it)
The settings button at the end of each feature row is a cleaner gear, smaller and centred
A chosen Off has a grey fill, so it reads as chosen
Grid Overlay: Its Weakest add-on is listed under it in Features
